description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for the shopping cart screen in a food delivery app. It manages cart display, item removal, and order placement with user feedback.

classes.name: CartScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the shopping cart screen, allowing users to view, remove items, and place orders.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the cart screen, displaying cart items and handling user interactions.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Asynchronous function to place an order using current cart items, clears the cart on success, and provides user feedback.
